entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It may be noted that there was a dispute in relation to the disbursement of compensation between the petitioner and his brother and the petitioner is claiming compensation for the entire acquired land on the basis of will of his mother.
The submission in the writ petition is that the dispute with the brother of the petitioner has come to an end with the withdrawal of his claim before the mutation court.
We may note that the brother of the petitioner, who allegedly has given up his claim for compensation is not impleaded in the present writ petition.
We, therefore, cannot issue any positive mandamus.

We may further note that the petitioner has approached this Court in Writ-C No. 2281 of 2021, Yogesh Kumar vs. Additional District Magistrate (Administration) and another, seeking similar relief and he was relegated to approach the competent authority to move an application under Section 3-H of the National Highways Act, 1956.

entities.text: Yogesh Kumar vs. Additional District Magistrate (Administration) and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is stated in paragraph-18 of the writ petition that the petitioner has moved an application dated 06.02.2021 before the competent authority, which has not been decided as yet.

During the course of submission, it was argued by the learned counsel for the petitioner that a direction be given to the competent authority to decide the pending application regarding release of the remaining part of the compensation, i.e. the compensation for the share of the brother of the petitioner as it has not been released till date.

Noticing the said submission, without entering into the merit of the claim of the petitioner, the present petition is being disposed off with direction to the competent authority to decide the application dated 06.02.2021 moved by the petitioner after giving due notice and opportunity to the other claimant, namely, the brother of the petitioner, about the claim of the petitioner for compensation on the basis of the will.

It goes without saying that the competent authority shall accord due consideration to the claim of the petitioner and also rival contentions of the other claimants while passing a reasoned and speaking order in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
